purpose: Research queue only. Not imported into the application; these are source records, not a count of new unique exercises.
method: Compare 1324 metadata records and 173 non-free-exercise-db OpenBody records with current English names. Normalize punctuation, word order and common inflections. Remaining names need manual semantic/equipment checks. Similarity is token Jaccard and is only a review aid. Names, aliases and equipment are retained; instructions and media are not copied.

openbody.media: Images and instructions are not supplied by this registry.

exercisedb-metadata.media: Gym visual images/GIFs are excluded from MIT. No media or media URLs copied. Reuse requires separate clearance.
